seo.title: Smarttnails by Ardak Aldanazarova — manicure and pedicure in Astana
seo.description: Nail artist Ardak: natural manicure, gel polish, French tips, extensions and pedicure in Astana. Rated 5.0 on 2GIS. Book online in a minute.

wear.q: How long does the polish last?
wear.a: Usually 3–4 weeks. I recommend a refill every 3 weeks so your nails always look fresh.

late.a: Message me on WhatsApp. Up to 15 minutes late is fine. Any later and we may need to reschedule or shorten the service.

cancel.q: How do I cancel or reschedule?
cancel.a: Message me on WhatsApp — please at least 3 hours in advance.

payment.a: Cash, card transfer or QR code.

kids.a: Yes — gently, with no e-file on the skin. Kids are welcome to come with a parent.

about.title: Creativity is my {accent}
about.quote: For me it isn't work — it's the joy of creating beauty.
about.p1: My name is Ardak Aldanazarova. My journey in nails began in 2017. For creative people there's no limit to perfection, and I find inspiration everywhere — in colour, in shape, in every client's mood.
about.p2: After maternity leave I took a break and even got into numerology. But my love of creating and my loyal clients didn't let me leave what I love — and now I'm back with fresh energy.
about.p3: I'm running my professional blog again, sharing new work and nail-care secrets. I'd be glad to have your follows and support.
